name: Protolabs
how_read: Plain HTTPS page fetch, no account, no quote; figures copied as published. Prose quotes are verbatim; 'table_row' quotes name the table, row and cells.
not_read: https://www.protolabs.com/services/cnc-machining/design-guidelines/ returned 404 (the milling design guidelines page was read instead).
